name: gesher-contacts
description: Find, read and edit Apple Contacts: search by name, phone or email, update phones/emails/addresses/birthdays, manage groups, upcoming birthdays, duplicates and vCards. Use for any question about the user's contacts.

interface.shortDescription: Look up and update your contacts
interface.longDescription: Search Apple Contacts by name (Hebrew included), phone number in any format or email; read full cards; create and update contacts value by value; manage groups; see upcoming birthdays; find likely duplicates; export and import vCards.
defaultPrompt: Add a work phone to Dana's card.
Whose birthdays are coming up this month?
